title: Scientists find traces of underground dwellers in mountains

tellings.quote: And I know some scientists who study caves and rocks. When I was in the Caucasus, when I was in India, in Tibet, in the Alaii, they found traces there,

plain: Traces of beings who live underground have been found in the mountains of the Caucasus, India, Tibet and the Altai, according to a guest presented on the show as the president of a Russian republic. He tells Michels that he knows scientists who study caves and rocks and that "they found traces there" during his own travels to those places, though he does not say what the traces were.
